title: Sales review, January to October
subtitle: Revenue grew in nine of ten months, to $15.9K in October.

sections.heading: Where it stands
sections.markdown:
Revenue grew every month but August. **North America** is still the biggest region, and **Pro** is most of the money.

- Europe is close behind
- Africa and the Middle East are small but growing

callout.label: The one number
callout.note: October revenue, the best month so far and 64% above January.

sections.heading: Next month
